page.layout: One column of running text (dictionary entries). Running head centred at top. Page number top right. Signature "L 4" centred at the foot. Catchword "rius" at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: re, Col. Decubare, Apul. Accubare eodem lecto, Liv. Re-cumbere, Cic. Jacere ad quartam, Hor. Accumbere, Plaut. Incubare, Id.
Cubare in latus] Incubitus lateris dextri valetudini conducit, Plin. Cubitus in latera conducunt adversum destillationes, Id.
Cubicularius] Præpositus cubiculo, Suet. Super somnum servus, Curt. A cubiculis.
Cubitus] Ossa cubita, Hippoc. Ulnis complecti, Claud.
Cudere] Procudere ensem, Hor. Ducere ære effigiem, Apul. Igni res tractare, Lucr. Stringere ferrum, Plin.
In formam calidæ percussit pondera massæ, Lucr.
Cudere monetam] Signare argentum, Cic. Nummos figurare, Lamp. Percutere nummos unâ formâ, Sen. Ferire pecunias, Plin.
Cujas? ] Cujatis? Plaut. Unde es gentium? Id. Qui genus? Unde domo? Virg.
Culcitra] Substramen, Var. Culcitrula, Plaut. Culcitella, Lipf.
Culex] Culex aculeatus. Conopœorum æstiva animalia, Plin. Scal. Centrines, Plin. Humoris alumnus, Virg. Sanguisuga, Hor.
Culina] Coquina, Non. Coquinula, Sipont. Fœdissimum patrimoniorum exitium, Sen.
Culinarius] Focarius, Sipont. Coquinarius culter, Var. Coquinatorius, Vlp.
Culmus] Culmus cerealis, fragilis, Virg. Calamus avenæ. Avena, Plin. Stipula, culmen fabæ, Ovid.
Culpam pœna sequitur] Peccati pœna sæva satelles.

Culpa in eo est] In culpâ, in crimine est. In noxiâ est. Acceptum illi referendum. Tenetur culpâ. Resider in eo culpa hujus rei. Culpam ejus rei sustinet. Est in vitio, Cic. Per testetit, quo minus fierent hæ nuptiæ. Ipse sibi injurius

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is present along the right side and was left out. The last word of the page, "injurius", is continued by the catchword "rius". The line "Per testetit" is printed that way and may be a printing error for a different word. Entries are set as separate paragraphs; the printed hanging indent was not clear enough to confirm each break exactly.
